plain.li: [summer] Long days ahead, a good time to start on "{AMBITION}".
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] Give me the hardest part of "{AMBITION}" and I'll start tomorrow.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Yes to "{AMBITION}", as long as someone else does the lifting.
[trait:Greedy] If "{AMBITION}" leaves us better off, I'm for it.
[old] I'd like to see "{AMBITION}" finished while I'm still around.
[child] I vote yes! Can I help?
[trusting] {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't steered us wrong yet, so yes.
[skill:Construction] A few strong backs and I'll have it started by the end of the week.
[summer] Let's talk about it again in the fall, not in this heat.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] That sounds like a lot of work, so no.
[trait:Ascetic] We don't need "{AMBITION}"; we need less, not more.
[old] I've seen plans like this end in a pile of half-cut stone.
[doubtful] The council's last plan isn't finished yet, is it?
[bitter] Another grand idea, and who gets ignored while we build it?

warm.li: Someone pass the blanket down to the end, it's cold over there.
Make room on the bench for the new one.

cold.li: I'm keeping track of who speaks most and says least.
The quiet ones are the ones to watch.
